extDescription.message: Redirect the new tab to your custom homepage

headerSubtitle.message: Set the site your new tab automatically opens to

hpHelp.message: Supports domains, intranet addresses and IPv6. HTTPS is assumed when the scheme is omitted; use http:// for local services.

errMsg.message: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL, e.g. kagi.com or http://localhost:3000/.

chipsAria.message: Quickly fill in a homepage URL

syncHelp.message: Saved on this device only by default. When enabled and saved, the current URL syncs to other devices with this option enabled; Chrome extension sync must be on. Turning it off only affects this device.

footerNote.message: Save after choosing or editing the URL · Site icons load locally

statusLoadFail.message: Couldn't load settings. Your existing settings are unchanged.

statusDirty.message: Unsaved changes — click Save settings to apply them.

statusSaved.message: Saved — takes effect on your next new tab. Current homepage: $URL$

statusSaveFail.message: Save didn't complete. Try again; if sync is enabled, check Chrome sync status.

statusRemoteUpdate.message: Homepage settings changed on another page or device. Your draft is kept; saving applies the draft.

statusRemoteReadFail.message: Couldn't read the updated settings. Reopen the settings page later.

warnInvalidSaved.message: Saved homepage URL is invalid — using the default homepage for now. Please save your settings again.

warnInvalidSync.message: Synced homepage URL is invalid — using this device's homepage for now. Please save your settings again.

warnSyncReadFail.message: Couldn't read synced settings right now — using this device's homepage.

recoverySlow.message: Redirect hasn't finished yet — open the homepage manually or check settings.

recoveryLoadFail.message: Couldn't read settings — trying the default homepage.

recoveryRedirectFail.message: Automatic redirect failed — open the homepage manually or check settings.
